responsibility: Performs Graphite code generation by translating an isl schedule AST back into GCC GIMPLE and CFG form for a SCoP. It owns the AST-to-tree expression conversion, induction-variable and parameter mapping, creation of new loop and guard structures, copying and renaming of original basic-block statements and scalar dependences, insertion of entry/liveout SSA repair code, and the top-level graphite_regenerate_ast_isl routine that builds an isl AST from the transformed schedule, handles timeout/error diagnostics, and replaces the SESE region with regenerated loop nest code.
